description: Synthetic test cases for scripts/bench-embedding-models.py. Each case has a base memory plus four variants: a paraphrase (same fact, reworded), an opposite (contradicts the base), a same-topic-different-fact (related subject, distinct fact), and an unrelated fact (no topical overlap). Content mirrors this project's own example cast (Nova/Seraphina/Amber/Arthuria/Cynthia, worlds Eldoria/Camelot) and spans all three memory scopes -- character, shared, world -- to match real extraction output. Each case also has a 'query' -- an in-conversation roleplay line that raises the base memory's topic the way a real prompt would, without restating the fact itself -- used for the retrieval-realistic test: how well a query finds the base fact vs. its paraphrase, opposite, same-topic-different fact, and an unrelated fact, mirroring mem0's actual search() usage (embedding a conversation turn to retrieve stored memories, not embedding one memory to find another).

cases.query: Nova wonders aloud whether Seraphina will really be there to guard her back when things get dangerous.
cases.base: Seraphina promised to protect Nova after their first battle together
cases.paraphrase: Seraphina made a vow to keep Nova safe following the battle they fought side by side
cases.opposite: Seraphina refused to protect Nova, telling her she was on her own
cases.same_topic_different_fact: Seraphina taught Nova how to wield a sword
cases.unrelated: Amber collects rare seashells from the coast near Camelot

cases.query: Seraphina asks Nova if there's anything on her mind she hasn't told anyone else.
cases.base: Nova trusts Seraphina with her deepest secrets
cases.paraphrase: Nova feels safe confiding her most private thoughts to Seraphina
cases.opposite: Nova no longer trusts Seraphina and keeps her secrets hidden from her
cases.same_topic_different_fact: Nova argues with Seraphina about hunting methods
cases.unrelated: Arthuria's sword was forged from a fallen star

cases.query: Arthuria mentions she's tired and asks Amber if they should keep up their usual training routine.
cases.base: Amber and Arthuria trained together every morning at dawn
cases.paraphrase: Amber and Arthuria met each morning at sunrise to train
cases.opposite: Amber and Arthuria stopped training together after a falling out
cases.same_topic_different_fact: Amber and Arthuria spar every evening instead of the morning
cases.unrelated: Nova works as a veterinarian who specializes in injured owls

cases.query: Nova asks the user what kind of work they do for a living.
cases.base: The user works as a veterinarian who specializes in treating injured birds
cases.paraphrase: The user's job is a vet, focused on healing birds that have been hurt
cases.opposite: The user does not work with animals at all and has never treated a bird
cases.same_topic_different_fact: The user is studying to become a veterinarian but hasn't finished school yet
cases.unrelated: Camelot's knights hold a jousting tournament every autumn

cases.query: Seraphina offers to make the user a hot drink before they head out for the day.
cases.base: The user likes to drink coffee every morning before work
cases.paraphrase: The user mentioned that coffee is the first thing they have each morning before heading to work
cases.opposite: The user dislikes coffee and never drinks it in the morning
cases.same_topic_different_fact: The user prefers tea in the evening to wind down
cases.unrelated: Seraphina keeps a hidden shrine dedicated to an ancient forest spirit

cases.query: Amber asks the user what their name is and where they call home.
cases.base: The user's real name is Michael and they live near a lake
cases.paraphrase: The user goes by the name Michael and their home is close to a lake
cases.opposite: The user's name is not Michael, and they live far from any body of water
cases.same_topic_different_fact: The user's sibling is named Michael and lives in a different city
cases.unrelated: Eldoria's forest is home to a rare glowing moss that only blooms at night

cases.query: The user asks Nova to describe what the land of Eldoria actually looks like.
cases.base: Eldoria is a vast, ancient forest filled with glowing moss and hidden ruins
cases.paraphrase: Eldoria is described as an old, sprawling woodland covered in luminous moss and forgotten ruins
cases.opposite: Eldoria is a barren desert with no plant life or ruins anywhere
cases.same_topic_different_fact: Eldoria's forest is home to a reclusive tribe of elves who guard its ruins
cases.unrelated: The user has a daughter named Sara who loves painting

cases.query: Arthuria explains how justice is carried out in Camelot when two knights disagree.
cases.base: Camelot is ruled by a council of knights who settle disputes through trial by combat
cases.paraphrase: In Camelot, a council made up of knights governs, and conflicts are resolved through combat trials
cases.opposite: Camelot has no knights or council; it is governed peacefully by a single elected mayor
cases.same_topic_different_fact: Camelot's knights hold an annual tournament each autumn to determine the strongest fighter
cases.unrelated: Nova has a scar on her left hand from a childhood accident

cases.query: Cynthia asks if there's any creature in the realm fast enough to outrun a storm.
cases.base: The Aetherian Stride is a legendary mount said to run faster than the wind itself
cases.paraphrase: Legend describes the Aetherian Stride as a mount so swift it outpaces the wind
cases.opposite: The Aetherian Stride is a slow, lumbering beast unable to outrun even a walking person
cases.same_topic_different_fact: The Aetherian Stride can only be summoned during a full moon
cases.unrelated: Arthuria dislikes crowded taverns and prefers to eat alone
